field.title: Where is your field?
field.description: Start by choosing your land. We will use its location to find relevant climate and soil data.
field.instructionOne: Find your area on the map.
field.instructionTwo: Click the map on your field. We look for its boundary; if none is found, the point is used.
field.instructionThree: Press “Analyze field” to get climate, soil and terrain data.
